ui.app.title: Avatar World
ui.app.description: Interactive globe of the Avatar world in three eras: Aang, Korra, and Pavi and Nisha. Non-profit fan project.
ui.error.load: The map could not be loaded. If you run this site, generate the tiles with "npm run tiles".
ui.error.webgl: Your browser could not start the 3D globe (WebGL unavailable or disabled).
ui.lang.autoFailed: Your browser cannot translate into this language; showing English.
ui.place.legacy: A place of the old world. Its situation in this era has not been revealed in the series yet.
ui.place.absent: This place does not appear in this era.
ui.era.legal: Non-profit fan project. Avatar: The Last Airbender, The Legend of Korra and Avatar: Seven Havens are trademarks of Nickelodeon/Paramount. The map painting is procedural and original (unless the site administrator uses other art); positions marked as estimated are approximations.
ui.editor.title: Developer mode
ui.editor.help: Drag the markers to fix positions. Click the map to copy a coordinate. Changes stay only in this browser until you send or export them.
ui.editor.tooMany: Too many edits for one submission; export places.json and open a pull request.
ui.editor.devNote: Submissions through GitHub are accepted from approved developers.
ui.editor.overlayHelp: Load a map image (flat projection, whole world) and align its bounds in degrees.

ui.omb.pickUser: Pick the person from the list

ui.rules.title: Community rules
ui.rules.intro: These rules apply to everyone and are enforced automatically by the database: nobody, not even the administrators, can apply them differently without leaving a trace. The numbers below are read live from the configuration.
ui.rules.cred1: You need to sign in to contribute. Credibility goes from 0 to {cred_max} and everyone starts with {cred_start}.
ui.rules.cred2: Contribution approved by the majority: +{gain_approved}. Just posting earns no points.
ui.rules.cred3: Contribution refuted by the majority: −{loss_refuted}. If the refutation is reversed, the points come back.
ui.rules.cred4: Whoever refutes must write a justification. The justification can also be approved or refuted and is worth ±{gain_just} to its author.
ui.rules.cred5: Credibility is always recalculated from the current result of the votes, so anyone can check the math.
ui.rules.vote1: Simple majority wins; for now, a single vote is enough.
ui.rules.vote2: The result always follows the current majority. In a tie (including 0 to 0), the contribution stays up, but it only earns points when there are more approvals than refutations.
ui.rules.vote3: A refutation only counts while its justification has not been refuted by the majority (replies and counter-replies follow the same rule).
ui.rules.vote4: Nobody votes on what they wrote.
ui.rules.vote5: To vote you need credibility {vote_min_cred} or more and an account at least {vote_min_days} days old.
ui.rules.limit1: Credibility below {limit1_below}: one contribution every {limit1_days} days.
ui.rules.limit2: Credibility below {limit2_below}: one contribution every {limit2_days} days.
ui.rules.limit3: Zero credibility: cannot contribute. After {zero_recover_days} days (about 6 months) at zero, credibility goes back to {zero_recover_to} and old contributions stop counting.
ui.rules.omb0: Anyone can report another person for harassment. The system cross-checks the data from the last {perse_window_days} days and confirms harassment if all three conditions are true at the same time:
ui.rules.omb1: Focus on one person: the accused refuted at least {perse_min_refutes} of the reporter's contributions.
ui.rules.omb2: Disproportion: more than half of all the accused's refutations in that period were against the reporter.
ui.rules.omb3: Unfair refutations: most of those refutations were reversed by the community.
ui.rules.omb4: If confirmed: the accused's account is banned and all their refutations against the reporter are annulled (the lost credibility comes back).
ui.rules.omb5: If not confirmed: the report is archived and the reporter sees which numbers fell short.
ui.rules.omb6: Anyone with {report_strikes} archived reports in a row cannot file reports for {report_block_days} days.
ui.rules.dev1: A separate track, without credibility: the request is made through GitHub and approved automatically.
ui.rules.dev2: Requirements: a GitHub account at least 6 months old and at least 30 contributions in the last 90 days (they can be on the same day).
ui.rules.dev3: And at least 1 merged pull request in someone else's project.
ui.rules.dev4: Anyone who doesn't qualify sees exactly what was missing and can ask again later.
ui.rules.transp1: Every profile has a public history with each gain and loss and the reason.
ui.rules.transp2: The result of every report is public, with the numbers used (the text and the reporter stay private).
ui.rules.transp3: The code of the site and of the rules is open on GitHub.

reino-da-terra.name: Earth Kingdom
reino-da-terra.desc: The largest nation in the world, covering almost the entire Great Continent. Diverse and decentralized, with local kings and governors under the authority of Ba Sing Se.

aang.desc: At war with the Fire Nation for a hundred years; it lost territory in the west to the Fire Nation colonies.

korra.desc: Shaken by the fall of the Earth Queen; Kuvira reunifies it by force as the Earth Empire, until she is stopped by Korra.

nacao-do-fogo.name: Fire Nation
nacao-do-fogo.desc: Volcanic archipelago west of the Great Continent, ruled by the Fire Lord from the Capital.

aang.desc: Industrial and military power waging the Hundred Year War since Sozin's attack on the Air Nomads.

korra.desc: A nation at peace, ruled by Fire Lord Izumi, Zuko's daughter.

tribo-agua-norte-regiao.name: Northern Water Tribe
tribo-agua-norte-regiao.desc: Northern polar territory, home of the largest of the Water Tribes.

tribo-agua-sul-regiao.name: Southern Water Tribe
tribo-agua-sul-regiao.desc: Southern polar territory, home of the Southern Water Tribe.

colonias-do-fogo.name: Fire Nation colonies
colonias-do-fogo.desc: A strip in the northwest of the Great Continent colonized by the Fire Nation during the war.

aang.desc: Mixed towns of Fire and Earth people, some more than a century old.

korra.name: United Republic of Nations
korra.desc: The former colonies form the United Republic of Nations, founded by Aang and Zuko after the Harmony Restoration Movement.

terras-duras.name: Harshlands
terras-duras.desc: Name given to the devastated world outside the havens, battered by storms after the Cataclysm.

deserto-si-wong.name: Si Wong Desert
deserto-si-wong.desc: A vast desert in the heart of the Earth Kingdom, crossed by sandbenders on sand sailers.

aang.desc: Appa is captured here by sandbenders.

pantano-nebuloso.name: Foggy Swamp
pantano-nebuloso.desc: A living swamp in the southwest of the Earth Kingdom, connected by the roots of a single giant tree. Home to an isolated tribe of waterbenders.

aang.desc: Team Avatar gets lost here and has visions of loved ones.

korra.desc: Toph Beifong lives in the swamp as a hermit and helps Korra recover.

mar-mo-ce.name: Mo Ce Sea
mar-mo-ce.desc: Sea between the Fire Nation and the Great Continent.

baia-yue.name: Yue Bay
baia-yue.desc: Bay where Republic City was built; named after Princess Yue.

lago-oriental.name: Eastern Lake
lago-oriental.desc: Lake crossed by the ferries that carry refugees to Ba Sing Se.

baia-lua-cheia.name: Full Moon Bay
baia-lua-cheia.desc: Hidden port in the center of the Earth Kingdom, from which the refugee ferries leave for Ba Sing Se.

baia-camaleao.name: Chameleon Bay
baia-camaleao.desc: Large bay on the east coast of the Great Continent. Identification on the map is estimated.

aang.desc: Meeting point of the Southern Water Tribe fleet led by Hakoda.

templo-ar-sul.name: Southern Air Temple
templo-ar-sul.desc: One of the four Air Nomad temples, in the Patola Mountain Range, in the Southern Archipelago.
refs: ATLA L1: The Southern Air Temple

aang.desc: Home of Aang and Monk Gyatso. Abandoned since Sozin's attack a hundred years earlier; Aang returns here and learns the fate of his people.

korra.desc: Kept by the Air Acolytes and visited by Tenzin's family.

templo-ar-norte.name: Northern Air Temple
templo-ar-norte.desc: Air Nomad temple at the far west end of the Taihua Mountains, in the north of the Great Continent.
refs: ATLA L1: The Northern Air Temple

aang.desc: Occupied by refugees led by the Mechanist, who filled it with steam-powered contraptions.

korra.desc: Seat of the new Air Nation: Tenzin trains the new airbenders here, until the Red Lotus attack.

templo-ar-oeste.name: Western Air Temple
templo-ar-oeste.desc: A temple built upside down on a cliff face, in a mountain range north of the Fire islands.
refs: ATLA L3: The Western Air Temple

aang.desc: Refuge of Team Avatar after the Day of Black Sun; this is where Zuko joins the group.

templo-ar-leste.name: Eastern Air Temple
templo-ar-leste.desc: Ancient temple of the Air Nomad nuns, in a mountain range southeast of the Earth Kingdom.

aang.desc: Aang trains with Guru Pathik to master the Avatar State by opening his chakras.

ilha-templo-ar.name: Air Temple Island
ilha-templo-ar.desc: Island in Yue Bay, facing Republic City.

korra.desc: Home of Tenzin, his family and the Air Acolytes; where Korra learns airbending.

capital-fogo.name: Fire Nation Capital
capital-fogo.desc: A capital built inside the crater of an extinct volcano, seat of the Royal Palace.
refs: ATLA L3: The Day of Black Sun

aang.desc: Target of the invasion on the Day of Black Sun; stage of the final Agni Kai between Zuko and Azula.

korra.desc: Seat of Fire Lord Izumi's government.

ilha-ember.name: Ember Island
ilha-ember.desc: Summer resort island of the Fire nobility, with beaches and the royal family's beach house.
refs: ATLA L3: The Ember Island Players

aang.desc: Team Avatar hides here and watches the play by the Ember Island Players.

ilha-crescente.name: Crescent Island
ilha-crescente.desc: Volcanic island in the east of the Fire Nation, home of Avatar Roku's Fire Temple.
refs: ATLA L1: Winter Solstice, Part 2: Avatar Roku

aang.desc: Aang speaks with Avatar Roku on the winter solstice; the temple is destroyed by the eruption.

ilha-roku.name: Roku's island
ilha-roku.desc: Avatar Roku's home island, in the east of the Fire Nation.
refs: ATLA L3: The Avatar and the Fire Lord

aang.desc: Devastated by an eruption about 70 years ago; Roku died trying to contain it.

rocha-fervente.name: Boiling Rock
rocha-fervente.desc: Maximum-security prison on an island in the middle of a boiling lake.

aang.desc: Sokka and Zuko break into the prison to rescue Hakoda and Suki.

guerreiros-do-sol.name: Sun Warriors' ancient city
guerreiros-do-sol.desc: Ancient city, in the northern islands of the Fire Nation, of the civilization that learned firebending from the dragons.

aang.desc: Zuko and Aang meet the dragons Ran and Shaw and rediscover the true meaning of fire.

fonte-de-fogo.name: Fire Fountain City
fonte-de-fogo.desc: Port city with an enormous fire-breathing fountain statue.

aang.desc: Toph and Sokka run scams here until they end up on wanted posters.
Katara confronts Yon Rha, the man responsible for her mother's death.

tribo-agua-norte.name: Agna Qel'a
tribo-agua-norte.desc: City of ice and canals, capital of the Northern Water Tribe.
refs: ATLA L1: The Siege of the North

aang.desc: Withstands Admiral Zhao's siege; Princess Yue becomes the Moon Spirit.

korra.desc: Ruled by Unalaq and later by Desna and Eska.

oasis-espiritual.name: Spirit Oasis
oasis-espiritual.desc: Warm sacred pond where Tui and La, the Moon and Ocean spirits, swim as koi fish.
refs: ATLA L1: The Siege of the North

portal-norte.name: Northern spirit portal
portal-norte.desc: Passage between the physical world and the Spirit World at the North Pole.

korra.desc: Opened by Korra at the end of Book 2.

tribo-agua-sul.name: Southern Water Tribe
refs: ATLA L1: The Boy in the Iceberg

aang.desc: Katara and Sokka's small village, where Aang is found in an iceberg.

korra.desc: It grew into a port city; home of Korra and stage of the Water Tribe Civil War.

portal-sul.name: Southern spirit portal
portal-sul.desc: Passage to the Spirit World at the South Pole, surrounded by the Spirit Wilds.

korra.desc: Reopened by Korra during Harmonic Convergence.

ba-sing-se.name: Ba Sing Se
ba-sing-se.desc: Capital of the Earth Kingdom, surrounded by concentric walls.
refs: ATLA L2: The Crossroads of Destiny

aang.desc: Secretly controlled by the Dai Li; falls to Azula at the end of Book 2 and is liberated by the Order of the White Lotus.

korra.desc: Earth Queen Hou-Ting is killed by Zaheer; the city later passes to Kuvira's Earth Empire.

havens.name: New Ba Sing Se
havens.desc: A haven in the northeast of the Great Continent, built where the old Earth Kingdom capital stood; its name preserves its ties to the Old World. It values old traditions and customs. Also called "New Ba".

lago-laogai.name: Lake Laogai
lago-laogai.desc: Lake inside the walls of Ba Sing Se.

aang.desc: Hides the Dai Li's secret base, where Appa was held prisoner.

omashu.name: Omashu
omashu.desc: A great city built on a mountain of the Kolau Mountain Range, in the southwest of the Earth Kingdom; famous for its delivery chutes.
refs: ATLA L1: The King of Omashu

aang.desc: Ruled by the eccentric King Bumi; occupied by the Fire Nation and renamed New Ozai, until it is freed during the eclipse.

caverna-dois-amantes.name: Cave of Two Lovers
caverna-dois-amantes.desc: Underground labyrinth created by Oma and Shu, the first earthbenders, giving access to Omashu.
refs: ATLA L2: The Cave of Two Lovers

gaoling.name: Gaoling
gaoling.desc: City in the south of the Earth Kingdom, home of the wealthy Beifong family.

aang.desc: Toph's hometown, where she secretly fought in the Earth Rumble tournament.

ilha-kyoshi.name: Kyoshi Island
ilha-kyoshi.desc: Island created by Avatar Kyoshi when she separated her homeland from the mainland; home of the Kyoshi Warriors.
refs: ATLA L1: The Warriors of Kyoshi

aang.desc: Team Avatar meets Suki and the Kyoshi Warriors.
Aang is put on trial for Kyoshi's alleged crime against Chin the Conqueror.

vila-senlin.name: Senlin Village
vila-senlin.desc: Village at the edge of the forest, in the south of the former colonies (later the United Republic), haunted by the spirit Hei Bai.
refs: ATLA L1: Winter Solstice, Part 1: The Spirit World

aang.desc: Aang calms Hei Bai and makes his first journey to the Spirit World.

makapu.name: Makapu Village
makapu.desc: Village in a valley at the foot of a volcano, in the northeast of the former colonies (later the United Republic); home of the fortuneteller Aunt Wu.

aang.desc: Aang and Katara save the village from an eruption.

grande-divisao.name: The Great Divide
grande-divisao.desc: The largest canyon in the world.

aang.desc: Aang guides two rival tribes across the canyon.

oasis-palmeiras.name: Misty Palms Oasis
oasis-palmeiras.desc: Run-down oasis on the edge of the Si Wong Desert.

aang.desc: Team Avatar meets Professor Zei, who is searching for the lost library.

biblioteca-wan-shi-tong.name: Wan Shi Tong's Library
biblioteca-wan-shi-tong.desc: Library of the spirit of knowledge, hidden in the desert sands.

aang.desc: Sokka discovers the date of the eclipse; the library sinks into the sand and returns to the Spirit World.

passagem-serpente.name: The Serpent's Pass
passagem-serpente.desc: Narrow strip of land in the northeast of the Earth Kingdom, between the Eastern Lake and the sea: a dangerous route to Ba Sing Se.

aang.desc: Aang faces the sea serpent that guards the pass.

floresta-wulong.name: Wulong Forest
floresta-wulong.desc: Forest on the west coast of the former colonies (later the United Republic).

aang.desc: Site of the final battle between Aang and Ozai during Sozin's Comet.
Center of the Harmony Restoration Movement crisis, right after the war.

cidade-republica.name: Republic City
cidade-republica.desc: Capital of the United Republic of Nations, a metropolis where people of every nation live.

korra.desc: Main setting of The Legend of Korra. After the battle against Kuvira, a spirit portal appears in the city center.

zaofu.name: Zaofu
zaofu.desc: Metal city founded by Suyin Beifong, protected by petal-shaped domes.

korra.desc: Home of the Metal Clan; taken by Kuvira in Book 4.

ellora.name: Ellora
ellora.desc: Main haven of the series and home of the twins Pavi and Nisha.

havens.desc: Cosmopolitan metropolis of over a million people in the southeast of the Great Continent, laid out as an octagonal mandala. A system of narrow canyons protects it from the sandstorms and tornadoes of the Harshlands.

ilhas-flutuantes.name: Floating Islands
ilhas-flutuantes.desc: A haven built on the water, near the coast.

havens.desc: Northeast of Ellora, where Chameleon Bay used to be. The exact position of the islands in the bay is an estimate. Explored in Book 2.

akasha.name: Akasha
akasha.desc: A haven of the Great Continent known for its technical skill: it survives with technologies from before the Cataclysm, such as motor vehicles.

havens.desc: The series only says it is on the Great Continent. The position is an estimate: Akasha should be the blue haven (the color of Ikaika's clothes), which the opening shows on the west coast of the continent. The fan theory that it is the former Zaofu does not match the official art, because Zaofu was inland in the southwest.

floresta-republica.name: Republic Forest
floresta-republica.desc: The "Lost Haven", which isolated itself from the rest of the world long before 399 AG. The Faceless believe there are no storms there and that benders and non-benders live in peace.

havens.desc: The violet haven, in the northwest of the Great Continent, roughly where Republic City used to be. The city appears overgrown with vegetation in the series' official images.

montanha-da-pena.name: Feather Mountain
montanha-da-pena.desc: A haven ruled by Empress Yeshe, which preserves the traditions of the Air Nomads: arrow tattoos, flying bison and voluntary service by benders.

havens.desc: The series has not said where it is yet. The position is an estimate: it should be the green haven (the color of Yeshe's clothes), which the opening shows in the southwest of the Great Continent. Fans bet it is where Omashu used to be.

refugio-ilhas-do-fogo.name: Fire Islands Haven
refugio-ilhas-do-fogo.desc: The seventh haven, whose name has not been revealed yet. It is in the former Fire Islands and is the most isolated of all.

havens.desc: The indigo haven. The series has only shown that it is in the Fire Islands. It is marked on the former Ember Island, which is the fans' bet, but the exact island has not been revealed.

arquipelago-do-sul.name: Southern Archipelago
arquipelago-do-sul.desc: Mountainous southern islands, traditional territory of the Air Nomads, home to the Patola Mountain Range and Whaletail Island.

montanhas-taihua.name: Taihua Mountains
montanhas-taihua.desc: A great mountain chain in the north of the Great Continent, from south of Ba Sing Se to the Northern Air Temple.

cordilheira-kolau.name: Kolau Mountain Range
cordilheira-kolau.desc: Mountain range in the southwest of the Earth Kingdom, home to Omashu and the Cave of Two Lovers; considered the birthplace of earthbending.
refs: ATLA L2: The Cave of Two Lovers

aang.label: Aang era
aang.summary: The Hundred Year War is coming to an end. The Fire Nation rules colonies in the west of the Earth Kingdom, and the Air Nomads were wiped out a century ago. Aang, the last airbender, awakens from an iceberg and must master the four elements before Sozin's Comet.
aang.sources: Avatar: The Last Airbender (2005–2008) and the sequel comics.

korra.label: Korra era
korra.summary: Seventy years after the war, the former colonies form the United Republic of Nations, with modern Republic City. Korra reopens the spirit portals, faces the Red Lotus and stops Kuvira's Earth Empire.
korra.sources: The Legend of Korra (2012–2014) and the sequel comics.

havens.label: Pavi and Nisha era
havens.summary: About 225 years after Korra, a Cataclysm brought down the Four Nations. Humanity survives in seven isolated havens, surrounded by the Harshlands and battered by storms. The twins Pavi and Nisha, from Ellora, are at the center of the dispute over who is the true Avatar.
havens.sources: Avatar: Seven Havens (2026–). Series currently airing: information and positions may still change. Akasha, Feather Mountain and the Fire Islands haven are at positions estimated from the official art of the seven havens seen from space.
